name: Cisco YANG Suite
description: Cisco's GUI-based tool suite for learning, testing, and adopting YANG programmable interfaces including NETCONF, RESTCONF, and gNMI. Supports YANG model browsing, RPC building, and device interaction.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official docker/ directory with start_yang_suite.sh script and docker-compose.yml. Docker-compose is the recommended installation method. Requires ~3.5GB RAM for large Cisco native models.

eval_notes: Docker-compose recommended install creates 3 containers (YANG Suite, Nginx, storage). NETCONF plugin builds XML payloads from YANG models. Supports get, get-config, edit-config, action RPCs. Requires 3.5GB RAM for large Cisco native models. Free from Cisco DevNet. Primarily a YANG development/testing tool rather than a standalone server, but useful for validating YANG models and testing NETCONF RPCs against devices. GUI-based — less suitable for automated agentic evals. Official Cisco tool for YANG/NETCONF testing. GUI-driven, good for interactive exploration. Docker-compose recommended deployment. Heavyweight but comprehensive for multi-protocol YANG testing. Cisco-maintained. Needs ~3.5GB RAM for large native models. Docker-compose recommended. YANG file manager, device manager, protocol testing. Docker-compose is recommended installation method. Not a NOS itself but essential tool for YANG/NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI development and testing. The most feature-rich YANG browser/explorer. Excellent for interactive YANG model exploration and RPC testing against real devices. Docker-compose deployment is straightforward. Best suited for development and learning workflows.
